_note: US11R leadership layer. Every leader sentence and every advisor line is Sam's, verbatim from US11R_NationBuilder_LeadershipSuccession_ContentPackage_2026-09-20.docx (sections 4-5). Two persistent government-tendency identities succeed and overthrow each other; their words change by era, which is Sam's Axis A. Ladders are his Axis B, keyed to the dominant unrest term. No ladder or label ever says 'conservative' or 'progressive', and none names its Civic Principle out loud.

unrest._note: Measured against real engine runs on 2026-09-20, not balanced: a town taxed to the ceiling and never policed sits in the high 50s to low 70s for years, a well-run one peaks near 2. A balance pass owns the final numbers (scope doc stage 4).

ladders._source: BK ruling 2026-09-20 number 2: build Rule of Law and Due Process as distinct ladders
ladders._note: Crime the leader's own conduct causes - skipping fair procedure - reads as Due Process, not Rule of Law. The selector is built and fires when the sitting leader's militarism disposition is high; Sam's package names the distinction but wrote no lines for it, and this build does not write them in his voice. With no tiers, the engine falls back to rule_of_law. NEEDS-SAM: three lines, same three-tier shape.

_choices_note: Advisor decisions: the buildconcept's conflicting-counsel mechanic (skill line DU), whose 8 save-code bits were reserved from the first format. Every advisor card must be answered before it leaves the screen, and the answer moves the town's numbers. The OPTION WORDING AND AFTERMATH LINES WERE WRITTEN BY THE BUILD SESSION 2026-09-20 as placeholders - the desks own this voice, and neither option should ever be the obviously right one.
_order_leader_note: order_leader is appended last because a leader's index is load-bearing for save codes. It arises only by overthrow: no leader lists it in succeeds_to, so scheduled succession still alternates the two tendencies. chooseSuccessor picks it when an overthrow is driven by crime or by power gathering in one office (its militarism outscores the others); an overthrow driven by approval, tax or unemployment still installs one of the two tendencies. Its own scheduled successor (limited_gov_leader) and its overthrow pool are the build session's choice and want Sam's confirmation.
